summary: Anthropic Messages API keeps mid-conversation system messages in place instead of merging them into the system prompt
compatibility: No user action required. Affects /v1/messages clients that send role: system messages inside messages, such as Claude Code system reminders.
details: Every such message was merged into the leading system prompt, so each new reminder changed the start of the prompt and the cached prefix was lost: on a recorded DeepSeek-V4.1 Claude Code session only about 4% of the previous prompt stayed reusable after a reminder arrived.
They now stay in place: as system messages on DeepSeek-V4.1 and GLM-5.3-Flash, whose formats have them, and as user messages on Qwen3.8 and DeepSeek-V4, whose templates accept system only first.
